english.title: Attempted arson with recklessness as to whether life was endangered
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to commit arson in that without lawful excuse, attempted to

(A)_[destroy]_
(B)_[damage]_

by fire **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..)

(C)_[to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..)]_
(D)_[of a value unknown]_

belonging to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) intending to destroy or damage property or being reckless as to whether property would be destroyed or damaged and being reckless as to whether the life of another would be thereby endangered
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1(2), 1(3) and 4 of the Criminal Damage Act 1971 and to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
